from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0062.png"))

# Let us find all 4 table leg bottom centers
# Table is between x = 240 and 380
# Find bottom row for each leg:
# Table front-left, front-right, back-left, back-right
# Let us inspect row by row from y=300 to y=390 across x=240 to 380
table_mask = (img[:, :, 0] > 90) & (img[:, :, 1] > 50) & (img[:, :, 2] < 50) & (np.arange(512)[:, None] > 280)
# Chair is on the right (x > 400)
# Table is x < 380
table_mask[:, 380:] = False

for y in range(400, 310, -1):
    cols = np.where(table_mask[y, :])[0]
    if len(cols) > 0:
        print(f"y={y}: cols from {cols.min()} to {cols.max()}, count={len(cols)}, cols={cols}")
'
